scope: Independent numerical and contract regression; not biological or usability certification

checks.question: Do original pixels, background correction and complementary regions yield the declared measurements?
checks.limit: Known numerical fixtures and region invariants do not validate segmentation on a new biological sample.

checks.question: Do contrasts, uncertainty and clustering agree with independent equations, including scale changes?
checks.limit: Algebraic agreement cannot establish experimental independence or remove acquisition and selection bias.

checks.question: Are vector figures source-linked and readable within the supported geometry checks?
checks.limit: Geometry checks are not an expert review of every legend, label collision or scientific interpretation.

checks.question: Are registered public-image parsing, numerical-reference and metadata failure paths preserved?
checks.limit: These are local regression fixtures. Actual downloaded images, Fiji runtime and external ImageJ measurements require their separate run receipts.

checks.question: Can explicitly named channels and original-coordinate regions be measured without false biological labels or assumed calibration?
checks.limit: Exact pixels, API ownership, corrections and replay are checked; new biological detector applicability and actual browser execution retain separate receipts.

checks.question: Can one reviewed field yield honest source-linked descriptions without inventing independent replication or inference?
checks.limit: Per-field distributions do not establish acquisition comparability, biological independence or group effects.

separate_gates: Pinned real Fiji integration and protected browser workflow
Source-hashed public raw-image runs with independent ImageJ measurements
Private field/sample-separated evaluation and legacy reconciliation
Expert and novice researcher usability sessions
Actual installed release and canonical production browser verification
